sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your counter-offer. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

If you require a 90-day payment term, our price must be adjusted to €5.02 per unit to account for the extended financing. Therefore, our updated offer stands at a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value your business and are always keen to work with you to find the right terms from our extensive range of services and products. We look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer. We always appreciate the opportunity to work closely with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to support your business with our extensive inventory and dedicated service.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Unfortunately, the slight adjustment does not allow us to reduce our price for a 90-day payment term. Our offer of €5.02 per unit remains our best possible price under these conditions. 

To confirm the full details, our current offer stands at a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our partnership and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months.
Here is the background.
Thank you for your revised offer.
Unfortunately, we are unable to accommodate any further price reductions for a 90-day payment term.
Therefore, we must present this as our final offer at €5.02 per unit.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
